Mr. SCHUMER (for himself, Mr. Rounds, Mr. Rubio, Mrs. Gillibrand, Mr. Young, and Mr. Heinrich) submitted an amendment intended to be proposed by him to the bill S. 2226 ... which was ordered to lie on the table; as follows: At the appropriate place, insert the following: TITLE _--UNIDENTIFIED ANOMALOUS PHENOMENA DISCLOSURE SEC. __01. Sec. 9010 was not enacted. It appears in the Senate-engrossed text of S. 2226 and in the Congressional Record text of S.Amdt. 797 (13 July 2023); it has no counterpart in Public Law 118-31.

edges.label: owns the only vehicle the disclosure text has ever ridden, and has never reported it
edges.note: Every version of the Act - 2023, 2024 and the announced later attempts - has reached the floor as an amendment to a SASC bill rather than as a committee product, which means no committee report, no markup record and no members professionally invested in defending it in conference. A committee's non-action is a process fact and belongs in this domain.

edges.label: passed one chamber, stripped in conference - the domain's instructive defeat
edges.note: The only text ever passed by a chamber of Congress legislating on the assumption that recovered non-human technology exists and is held in part by private entities. It rode to the Senate floor as an amendment, cleared the Senate as a division of S. 2226, and did not survive conference into P.L. 118-31 in that form. The mechanism of the defeat is the lesson, which is why it belongs to process rather than to statute.
